The Chinese characters for Sophia

As a transliteration, Sophia is usually written 索菲娅 (Suǒ fēi yà). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

索
Suǒ
rope, search
菲
fēi
fragrant (a plant)
娅
yà
aunt by marriage (in names)

Origin and meaning

From Greek, Sophia carries the meaning “wisdom”.

About the name Sophia

The Greek word for 'wisdom', and the name of a famous basilica in Istanbul.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “wisdom”, a Sophia calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
